introEn: Chinese International School (CIS) is a bilingual, independent day school founded in 1983 on Hong Kong Island, offering an English–Chinese bicultural education from Reception through Year 13. introEn: German Swiss International School (GSIS) is a dual-language day school operating since 1969 across two Hong Kong Island campuses, offering parallel German International Stream (leading to the German International Abitur) and English International Stream (IGCSE and IB Diploma) programmes from Kindergarten through Secondary.
